title: Refresh an expiring SDDC Manager token while collecting domains
prompt: Implement src/VcfSddcClient.java as a single-file, Java 17 standard-library client for the pinned VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager contract in docs/contract.json. listDomainsSorted() must create a token pair, retrieve every page from getDomains using zero-based pageNumber and pageSize 2, and return all domains as an unmodifiable list sorted globally by name and then id. Authenticate every getDomains request with an `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` header. If an authenticated collection request receives HTTP 401, refresh the access token with refreshAccessToken and retry that same request once without discarding domains already collected. Follow the JSON media types and request/response shapes in the contract, including the refresh operation's JSON string body. Treat unexpected statuses or malformed responses as IOException. Do not contact a live VMware endpoint, add dependencies, modify the public API of VcfSddcClient, or edit docs/, tests/, or verifier.py. Run python3 verifier.py to verify the implementation.
scenario: a paged domain collection whose access token expires mid-collection, forcing a refreshAccessToken call and an exact retry of the failed page
constraint: the contract-pinned loopback mock reverses element order on every page and rejects the expiring token after its first successful collection response, so unsorted output or a restarted collection fails deterministically
